scope: V2 step 007: genuine 32/64/128-task lifetimes, worlds 0-2, bracketing rho
verdict: the crossover between rho 0.75 and 0.9 is stationary across a 4x range of genuine lifetime lengths: signs are unanimous at every N and magnitudes scale roughly linearly in N, i.e., per-task effects are approximately stationary. H5a's lifetime-length dependence is closed with real runs: amortization movement is confined to very early lifetime (16-32 tasks, from the truncation bridge) and the boundary is N-invariant from 32 to 128 tasks.
